desc:
🏙️ Welcome to Metrópoles RP, the most immersive Brazilian roleplay on Roblox, set in a vibrant, bustling São Paulo full of opportunities!

💼 Work as a doctor, motorcycle rider, truck driver, app driver, and much more: build your story from scratch in Brazil's largest metropolis!
🏠 Buy your house, acquire your vehicle, accumulate money, and rise through life. The limit is you!
🔫 Prefer the wrong path? Enter the criminal world, participate in escapes and robberies, and dominate the São Paulo underworld!
👮 Restore order in the city: join the police, patrol the streets, and make arrests!

🎮 Keys:
🎒 Search - /search <user>
🤝 Exchange - /trade <user>
🔒 J - Lock/Unlock
🔫 F - Store weapon
🎒 TAB - Backpack
🤸 V - Roll
🚨 H, P, J, K - Giroflex and Sirens
💪 P - Load body
🏃 Shift - Run
📸 Ctrl - Lock camera

⭐ Did you like it? Leave a like and favorite to support the project!
🖥️ Full support for PC, mobile, tablet, and console.
